coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Hudson et al. (2000), Icarus 148, 37–51; Goldstone radar, optical light curves and NASA/JPL: ecliptic J2000 lambda 202 deg, beta -45 deg, period 6.0289 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The 1995 radar reconstruction resolves global shape at tens of meters. Its angular edges and concavities are modeled geometry, not measured optical texture; the archived Cartesian X/Y/Z extents correspond to the intermediate/long/short principal axes.
